intro_md:
Need a song for your boombox? Here’s a large, up-to-date list of working Roblox Music Codes/IDs, also called song IDs or sound IDs.

how_it_works_md:
## What are Roblox Music Codes?

A **Roblox Music Code** is a numeric audio asset ID that points to a sound or music file uploaded to Roblox. Games that support custom audio can use this number to play music through a **boombox, radio, DJ booth, or music player**.

A Music Code is always a number. You copy it and paste it into a supported game.

Example:

- Music Code: `1234567890`

Music Codes only work in experiences that allow custom music input. If a game does not support custom audio, the Code will not play even if the audio itself is valid.

Many Roblox experiences allow players to play their own music using Music Codes. Support depends on the game, server settings, and sometimes player permissions.

Below are some popular games where custom music is commonly supported:

Some experiences require a **gamepass, in-game currency, or private server** to use music features. Availability may also change with updates.

If a game does not allow custom audio, Music Codes will not work there even if the ID itself is valid.

## How to use Roblox Music Codes

Playing music with a Roblox Music Code is straightforward once you are in a supported experience. You only need the Music Code and access to the game’s music menu.

1. Join a Roblox experience that supports custom music.
2. Open the boombox, radio, DJ booth, or music player.
3. Copy a Music Code from the list.
4. Paste the Music Code into the input box.
5. Press Play and keep your volume turned on.

Some games restrict music to certain players or require a gamepass. If you are unsure, test the Code in a free music-testing experience like FREE RADIO [BOOMBOX] HANGOUT.

## Music card labels explained

Each entry includes labels to help you understand what the audio is and how it can be used.

- **Music ID** – The numeric Roblox audio asset ID a.k.a Music Code. Paste any Roblox link or ID into the [Roblox ID Extractor](https://bloxodes.com/tools/roblox-id-extractor) to confirm what type it is.
- **Song Title** – Name of the track, when available
- **Artist / Album** – Uploaded or detected metadata
- **Duration** – Length of the audio
- **Genre / Tags** – Used for filtering and discovery
- **Top #** – Popularity indicator based on internal ranking signals
- **Copy** – Copies the Music Code to your clipboard
- **Play on Roblox** – Opens the Roblox audio asset or playback page, if supported

## Roblox Music Code not working? Common reasons and fixes

If a Roblox Music Code does not play, it does not always mean the ID is broken. Most issues are caused by moderation, permissions, or game restrictions.

### Why Music Codes stop working

Roblox audio availability can change at any time. Common reasons include:

- The audio was deleted or moderated by Roblox
- The creator made the audio private
- Audio permissions were changed or restricted
- The game does not allow custom music
- The game only supports whitelisted or approved audio

Codes that stop working get removed from the list regularly.

### What to try before moving on

If a Code does not play, try the following steps:

1. Copy and paste the Music Code again to avoid errors.
2. Restart Roblox and rejoin the game.
3. Test the Code in a different experience that supports music.
4. Check whether the audio is private or deleted.
5. Make sure your sound settings and volume are enabled.
6. If the game restricts music, the ID may not be playable there.

If the Code still does not work, it is best to try another Music Code from the list.

## Copyright, safety, and availability

We don’t knowingly list illegal or unlicensed uploads. All audio moderation is handled by Roblox, and availability can change without notice.

Some sounds may work in one game but not another due to different permission systems. The list is meant for **discovery and convenience**, not guaranteed playback in every experience.

Use the **[Contact Us](https://bloxodes.com/contact)** page to report broken Codes or submit new Music Codes. Including the Code and where you tested it helps us review and update the list faster.
